synthesis: The source places approximation freedom on either side of the same overlap: it can keep the Riemann–Siegel evolution fixed and reweight the reference state to obtain the smoother Berry–Keating expression with its first correction, or it can keep the overlap objective while allowing effective dynamics with inaccurate termwise phases because periodicity, amplitude decay, and cross-term compensation preserve the aggregate output.
source_support: Unit u09 defines a parameter-dependent Berry–Keating reference state whose overlap with the unchanged Riemann–Siegel state produces ζBK and includes the first Riemann–Siegel correction. Unit u12 derives an effective Jaynes–Cummings-like Hamiltonian and explicitly explains why its overlap can approximate ζ even when its exponents are not close term by term: phases matter modulo 2π, n^(-σ) weights suppress large-index errors, and deviations can compensate in the summed overlap.
nonparaphrase_operation: Move the approximation burden across the overlap interface—from the reference functional in u09 to the state-generating dynamics in u12—and identify output-level agreement, rather than componentwise fidelity, as the common design criterion.
limits: The first construction incorporates only a stated main term and first correction and remains parameter-dependent; it is not an error-certified implementation of the complete formula. The effective-Hamiltonian example is heuristic, parameter-selected, and plot-based, with optimization deferred. The two units provide no uniform error bound, no proof that reference reweighting and dynamical approximation are equivalent or freely interchangeable, and no certification of zero preservation.
quality_reason: This is a concrete cross-unit synthesis rather than a shared-theme paraphrase: u09 locates a refinement in a changed reference state while leaving the evolved state unchanged, whereas u12 locates tolerated error in the generator and shows three mechanisms by which the final weighted overlap masks it. Their conjunction supports the source-level contrast between correcting the readout and relaxing internal dynamics, while the stated limits preserve the distinct approximation burdens and unresolved proof obligations.
